skill.name: create-pr
skill.description: Create pull requests that follow Sentry-style review, title, and description conventions.
skill.summary: Guides agents through branch checks, PR descriptions, titles, and reviewer setup for Sentry-style pull requests.

content.value_statement: Pull request descriptions often miss the context reviewers need. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code prepare concise PRs with Sentry-style titles, rationale, and reviewer guidance.
actual_capabilities: Checks branch state with git status and commit history commands.
Reviews the diff against main before drafting the pull request.
Guides PR descriptions toward motivation, alternatives, and reviewer context.
Applies Sentry-style title examples for feature, fix, and refactor changes.
Shows how to create a PR with GitHub CLI and optionally request reviewers.
limitations: Requires an authenticated GitHub CLI before PR creation can work.
Assumes the repository uses main as the base branch.
Does not validate Sentry issue IDs or reviewer names automatically.
It is tailored to Sentry conventions, which may not match every team.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feature PR
use_cases.description: Draft a feature pull request that explains motivation, scope, and reviewer context before opening it.

use_cases.title: Standardize Bug Fix Reviews
use_cases.description: Create a bug fix PR with a clear failure explanation, issue reference, and focused review guidance.

use_cases.title: Coach New Contributors
use_cases.description: Help contributors follow team PR conventions without memorizing title formats and description rules.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request after commits are ready.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the create-pr skill to inspect my branch and draft a Sentry-style pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Before Creating
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants to review the text first.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the create-pr skill to analyze my diff and propose the PR title and body before running gh pr create.

prompt_templates.title: Open a Bug Fix PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the create-pr skill to create a bug fix PR for this branch. Include the relevant issue reference and explain the user impact.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Reviewer Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with targeted review guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the create-pr skill to create a PR that highlights risky areas, alternatives considered, and specific files reviewers should inspect closely.

output_examples.input: Create a PR for my completed Slack notification branch.
output_examples.output: A concise feature PR title, a description explaining why threaded notifications help, and a GitHub CLI command ready for confirmation.

output_examples.input: Draft a PR body for this null response bug fix.
output_examples.output: A bug fix description that explains the crash, the null handling change, and the issue reference without adding a test checklist.

output_examples.input: Help me request the right reviewers for this change.
output_examples.output: A recommendation to keep reviewers limited, plus a GitHub CLI reviewer command when specific users or teams are known.

best_practices: Commit and review all branch changes before asking the skill to create the PR.
Include the issue or ticket reference so the PR description has business context.
Review the generated title and body before allowing commands that publish the PR.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to bundle unrelated fixes into one pull request.
Do not ask it to skip branch status or diff review before PR creation.
Do not add long test-plan checklists when your team convention excludes them.

faq.question: Does this skill create the pull request automatically?
faq.answer: It provides GitHub CLI commands and can help run them when you approve the action.

faq.question: Which base branch does it expect?
faq.answer: The instructions compare the current branch against main.

faq.question: Can it add reviewers?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to add individual reviewers or a GitHub team with gh pr edit.

faq.question: Does it include a test plan section?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly tells the agent not to include test plan sections or checkbox lists.

faq.question: Is it only useful for Sentry repositories?
faq.answer: It is optimized for Sentry conventions, but the branch review and PR writing flow can help similar engineering teams.

faq.question: What tools must be installed?
faq.answer: Git and an authenticated GitHub CLI are needed for the documented commands.
